title: Covering applies only to what the shop named, within one schedule
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in with View customers; a schedule has a service that NAMES other services as covered (per S2-R16), plus a compliance inspection, on an enrolled asset. Flag on.
custom_steps:
1. Bring the covering service due and complete it.
  2. Check the covered services it named.
  3. Check a service on a DIFFERENT schedule is not covered.
  4. Check a compliance inspection is never covered.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Covering is what a shop states, never inferred from interval length or shared lines; within one schedule a service covers the services it names.
  • Across schedules nothing is covered.
  • Covered services reset with the one that covers them, each on its own interval.
  • A compliance inspection is never covered.
